status: preregistration; no predictor trained on apple-look-v1; no readout fitted
what_this_task_is: a world-model test only: an action-conditioned LeWM predictor on frozen DINOv2 CLS latents, trained on apple-look-v1 train sessions and measured offline; no control formulation preregistered or implied
claim_scope: WM-DYNAMICS would say: at h = 8 and 16 on 170 cross-fitted train sessions, this predictor on this frozen feature does not collapse, beats copy-last and a no-action predictor, uses the actions, and keeps the post-look apple readable (TASK-059 T1 bar, within 0.5 cm of the encoded target); nothing about control, the test split, longer horizons or other encoders
control_lines: CEM abandoned as the primary control line at TASK-054; the behaviour-cloning line stopped at TASK-057; both clauses hold; no control formulation preregistered or implied

predecessor.row_next: a separately preregistered world-model task on apple-look-v1 with this frozen encoder as a candidate image encoder; no control formulation implied

facts.corpus: 200 roots + 599 branches, 200 345 transitions; train 679 / val 80 / test 40

caveats_carried_forward: P-cls is not detectably different from raw pixels; no equivalence margin
random-init features also read the apple (R-tok met every bar; R-cls missed T3 only)
one encoder, one input size, one floor seed
the cause (pretraining data, width, input size) is not identified
readability is not prediction (this task is the first prediction test)
render nondeterminism: a re-collection would not reproduce the dataset hash

halves.rule: sorted train sessions permuted by default_rng(65); first 85 = A
halves.probe_roots: cross-fitted: each train root predicted by the half model that never trained on it, read by the probe fold that held it out

model.predictor: pinned upstream LeWM ARPredictor + Embedder + pred_proj via the adapter's unchanged next_embedding; history one

option.class: frozen_encoder_model(BACKEND): FrozenEncoderMixin in front of the backend
option.off_unless_selected: plain backends reject the key; the frozen class requires it
option.why: TASK-054's E0 checkpoint implementation_sha256 covers those files (tests/test_policy_preflight.py); editing them would orphan it

frozen_encoder.name: dinov2_small_cls
frozen_encoder.read_out: CLS after the final LayerNorm (pooler_output), 384-d, CPU float32
frozen_encoder.input: 112 px uint8 -> 224 px bicubic, no crop, ImageNet normalisation

model.normalisation: per-dimension mean/std of the raw CLS over the model's training-half frames, std floored at 1e-3
model.metric_scale: per-dimension std of the raw CLS over every frame of the 170 train sessions, floored at 1e-3

arms.N: every action zero in training and evaluation (no-action baseline)

training.sampler: default_rng(SeedSequence([6500, seed, half index])), shared by W and N (paired); uniform over every valid 16-transition window of the half's train episodes
training.selection: val criterion (normalised MSE over steps 1..16, val windows at stride 4) every 500 updates; lowest kept, ties to the earlier

evaluation.E_all: every train window of 16 transitions starting at every 4th frame, predicted by the other half's model
evaluation.E_post: the 170 train roots from frame 8 with their executed actions

probe.readouts: info_ceiling nested CV (linear + RBF kernel ridge, lambda 1e-4..1e4)
probe.fit_on: encoded raw CLS of frame 8 + h of the 170 train roots, 10-fold CV

gates.per_seed_rule: a gate passes for a seed only if it passes at h = 8 and h = 16; the seed passes if G1-G5 all pass

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.V: a guard fails or the run stops early; nothing is read; one repeat
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.WM-UNSTABLE: one or two seeds pass; clause does not fire
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.WM-APPLE-LOST: no seed passes; G1-G4 pass on at least two seeds; clause fires

inconclusive_task_level: a second V closes TASK-065 as INCONCLUSIVE; the clause does not fire

abandonment_clause.closes: an action-conditioned LeWM-family predictor on frozen, externally pretrained pooled (CLS) latents on apple-look-v1; no further predictor variant with frozen pooled pretrained latents on this corpus without new evidence of a different kind
untested_not_refuted: a trainable encoder initialised from the pretrained one

void_rule: an early stop is V with a void_reason; one from-scratch repeat into run-2 with the same seeds, caps and device and recomputed features; a second V is INCONCLUSIVE; rulings recorded with a UTC timestamp before the run they affect

budget.expected: features ~45 min; ~10 min per model; ~3 h total

run_command: uv run --no-sync python scripts/train_apple_latent_dynamics.py run --output outputs/task065-latent-dynamics/run-1 --checkpoints checkpoints/task065-latent-dynamics/run-1

pre_freeze_facts.label_inspection: apple/palm/phase labels of 40 train roots (look-47000..look-47045) read while designing horizons; no feature, prediction or readout computed

process: PR 1: protocol, manifest, latent_dynamics.py, frozen_encoder option, tests, card
PR 2: runner, guard tests, runner pin
gated run on the pre-run reviewer's reported verdict only
PR 3: results doc, results manifest, summarize script; numbers checked by script
